title: The Future of Finance is on Coinbase | Brian Armstrong, CEO
description:
The future of finance is on Coinbase. Hear from CEO Brian Armstrong on why people deserve more from our outdated financial system and how crypto makes it possible. 

__

At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

#coinbase #crypto #bitcoin #blockchain 

__

This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only. Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice. This content, and any information contained therein, does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.

asr.full_text: it goes round and round and when it stops no one knows but when it does... people panic. Things fail, everyone struggles, then they paper over it debate what happened for years figure it out, change nothing, rinse, repeat rinse repeat, Or rebuild it entirely. What if we actually updated the financial system? With a new kind of infrastructure, for new kinds of products to do anything money can do, Better, faster, more secure, more transparent, more accessible. A financial system that works for... everyone, all in one place. It's time for a system update. . Please welcome Brian Armstrong. . Hi, everyone. Okay. Hi everyone. Thank you for coming today, whether you're here at Fort Mason or watching online. I'm excited to welcome you to the first Coinbase system update. Today we'll update you on everything we've built in the second half of this year. We started Coinbase with a simple belief that people deserve more from the outdated financial system, and crypto makes it possible. Eighty-seven percent of Americans say fees are delays and unequal access in the current system, it's just not working for them. They're looking for new ways to grow their wealth and participate in the economy. We have an opportunity to use crypto to update the financial system and increase economic freedom in the world. For example, if you've ever tried sending money abroad, you know how painful it is. Not everyone has access to banking. Traditional bank hours are 9-4, Monday to Saturday. Trading hours for most assets are even shorter. Capital formation is only available to a select few. And middlemen take a slice of everything you do. Cryptocurrency addresses so many of these problems, making the financial system faster, cheaper, easier, more rewarding and more accessible. That's why for the last 13 years we've been relentlessly updating the system, so anyone can achieve economic freedom. Coinbase builds products to help individuals, businesses, financial institutions, governments. We've also built a developer platform to make crypto integration effortless for any company. And these are our custodial offerings where we store private keys and funds on your behalf, providing convenience, security, recovery options, and regulatory compliance. We've also added a set of non-custodial products from the base app, which gives you complete control of your own funds. These allow us to innovate on the frontier and reach more countries globally. So you'll hear updates on each of these today. We are growing each of these products with this virtuous flywheel. Customers know that we are the most trusted name in crypto. So they store their assets with us. They are more likely to use projects where their assets already reside this drives customer retention allowing us to invest back in trust in the cycle repeats accumulating more assets on Coinbase today to the best of our knowledge Coinbase stores more crypto than any other company in the world in fact our assets on Platform have grown 5x over the past three years. As of Q3, we had more than $500 billion in crypto assets on Platform. Our goal is to become the number one financial service app in the world. And to do that, we need to be the most trusted place to manage your entire financial life. So to that end, we've been building across these three phases of crypto adoption. Number 1, investment, number 2, financial services, and 3, an app platform for developers to build on. Let's start with investment. Trading has always been crypto's first use case. Coinbase has been the leader in US spot trading. We started by offering trading of just a few crypto assets. Then we got to a few hundred. And there are now millions of assets on Coinbase with decentralized exchange integration available for trade. Placing us far ahead of the competition. People love trading crypto. But they're also looking to build wealth with a broader set of assets. So, in a few moments, you're going to hear how Coinbase is now the best place to trade every asset, not just crypto. Customers want one place where they can trade equities, prediction markets, commodities, using spot trading, derivatives and options. As every asset class comes on-chain, we can build faster, cheaper, and more global markets. Coinbase is no longer a place to just trade crypto, it's a place where you can trade everything. And the Everything Exchange creates a future where every asset is tokenized, accessible to everyone, in one, seamless, secure, user-friendly experience. That's investment. Now, we're not just a trading platform, we're a place to also manage your entire financial life. And so when we bring the financial services onto crypto rails we're able to offer services that are faster, cheaper with greater rewards. So today we'll share some new ways that Coinbase financial services could unlock opportunities beyond what traditional banks offer. Finally, we'll talk about how we're building crypto infrastructure that any business or developer can use my based developer platform or CDP is our crypto as a service offering which makes it seamless for any company to integrate custody trading payments and stable coins today we'll share a slate of new APIs and services for CDP. We have also incubated the most popular Layer 2 blockchain on top of Ethereum, called base, which enables developers to build a powerful crypto utility in any app. Today we're going to share the latest product updates on the base app, our self custodial wallet, it makes it easy for anyone to get on-chain, anywhere in the world. Over the next hour you are going to hear why we believe the future of finance is on Coinbase.
